q: The Tropic of Cancer passes through how many Indian states?
x: Gujarat, Rajasthan, MP, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, West Bengal, Tripura and Mizoram.

q: Which Indian state touches three countries: Bangladesh, Nepal and Bhutan?
x: West Bengal borders Bangladesh, Nepal and Bhutan. Sikkim touches Nepal, Bhutan and China.

q: Which is the highest peak of South India?
x: Anamudi (2,695 m) in Kerala's Anaimalai Hills. Doddabetta is the highest in the Nilgiris.

q: Which is the highest peak fully inside India's administered territory?
x: Kanchenjunga (8,586 m) on the Sikkim–Nepal border. K2 is higher but lies in Pakistan-occupied Kashmir, which India claims.

q: Which two big rivers flow west into the Arabian Sea through rift valleys?
x: Narmada and Tapi flow west through rift valleys and form estuaries, not deltas.
Amarkantak in the Maikal Range. The Tapi rises at Multai, the Godavari at Trimbakeshwar, the Krishna at Mahabaleshwar.

q: Which soil is best for cotton?
x: Black soil holds moisture well, which suits cotton.

q: The India State of Forest Report is published by ___ every ___.
o: Forest Survey of India; two years
Wildlife Institute of India; five years
x: The Forest Survey of India, Dehradun, publishes it every two years.

q: Which state has the largest forest area?
x: Madhya Pradesh has the largest forest area. By percentage of its own area, Mizoram leads.

q: In which state is the Nathu La pass?
x: Nathu La in Sikkim links India with Tibet (China).

q: The border line between India and China in the east is called the…
x: The McMahon Line (1914). Durand Line = Pakistan–Afghanistan; Radcliffe Line = India–Pakistan/Bangladesh.

q: Most of India's coal is found in which rock system?
x: About 98% of India's coal is Gondwana coal, found in Damodar, Mahanadi and Godavari valleys.

o: Violent April–May thunderstorms in Bengal and Odisha
Hot dry winds of north India in summer
x: Kalbaisakhi or Nor'westers. Loo is the hot wind; mango showers are in Kerala/Karnataka; western disturbances bring winter rain.

q: Which is the largest biogeographic zone of India?
x: The Deccan Peninsula covers about 42% of India's area.
